name: Manchester City

tactical_patterns.build_up: Short passing from back, GK involved in build-up. FBs invert into midfield zones. Single pivot (Rodri) drops between CBs. Progressive passing rate: 8.2 per 90 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Overloads in half-spaces. Width from inverted wingers and overlapping FBs. Late runners into box. High sustained possession (64% avg). xG per 90: 2.1 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.defensive: High press triggered by opponent GK or CB receiving ball. Counter-press immediately on loss. PPDA: 8.4 (FBref). Compact midfield block when settled.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Dangerous from corners (near post flicks). De Bruyne delivery from free kicks. Haaland primary aerial target. Set piece xG: 0.31 per match (FBref).
tactical_patterns.transitions: Quick vertical passes on turnover. Haaland stretches defensive line. Vulnerable to fast breaks when FBs are high.

strengths: Set piece threat (top 3 in PL for set piece xG)
weaknesses: Vulnerable to pace on counter-attacks (conceded 8 transition goals, Football-Data.org)
Over-reliance on Rodri for midfield control
High defensive line exploitable with long balls behind
Can struggle against deep compact blocks (xG drops to 1.3 vs low-block teams)

name: Real Madrid

tactical_patterns.build_up: Patient build-up through midfield. Ball progression from deep via CBs. FBs provide width. Progressive passing rate: 7.1 per 90 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Devastating transitions with Mbappé and Vinícius. Bellingham late arrivals in box. Crosses from wide areas. xG per 90: 1.9 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.defensive: Mid-block with compact shape. Rely on individual brilliance to recover. Press selectively on triggers. PPDA: 12.6 (FBref — low pressing intensity).
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Strong aerial threat from corners (Rüdiger, Bellingham). Direct free kicks from Mbappé. Set piece xG: 0.28 per match (FBref).
tactical_patterns.transitions: Elite counter-attacking speed. 3-4 seconds goal-to-goal. Mbappé-Vinícius combination lethal on break. 14 transition goals this season (Football-Data.org).

strengths: Devastating pace on transitions (14 transition goals, top in La Liga)
Strong aerial presence from set pieces
weaknesses: Defensive structure without the ball (PPDA 12.6 — passive press)
Over-reliance on individual moments vs organized defenses
Midfield can be overrun by high-pressing teams
Inconsistent pressing — gaps between lines exploitable

name: Liverpool

tactical_patterns.build_up: GK distribution to FBs. TAA inverting as playmaker. Quick vertical progression through midfield. Progressive passing rate: 9.1 per 90 (FBref — highest in PL).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Salah cutting inside from right. Robertson overlaps on left. Third-man runs from midfield. Direct passing into channels. xG per 90: 2.3 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.defensive: Aggressive high press in opponent's half. Gegenpressing on loss. PPDA: 7.2 (FBref — most intense press in PL). Compact mid-block when press is beaten.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: TAA delivery from corners and free kicks. Van Dijk primary aerial target. Near-post routines. Set piece xG: 0.35 per match (FBref — top in PL).
tactical_patterns.transitions: Fast vertical play on turnovers. Salah stretches play. Midfield runners support quickly. 11 transition goals (Football-Data.org).

strengths: Elite pressing intensity (PPDA 7.2 — best in PL, FBref)
Strongest set-piece threat in the league (0.35 xG/match)
Tactical organization and structure under Slot
Midfield balance — Gravenberch interceptions + Mac Allister progression
weaknesses: TAA defensive vulnerability (1v1 defending, positional lapses)
High line exploitable with pace behind (van Dijk recovery speed)
Can be disrupted by physical, direct midfields
Transition defending when press is broken (conceded 7 post-press goals)

name: Arsenal
style: Structured possession, set-piece mastery, controlled aggression

tactical_patterns.build_up: Structured build-up from back with Saliba/Gabriel split wide. Raya involved in short distribution. Rice drops alongside CBs to create 3v2 overloads. Timber inverts from RB. Progressive passing rate: 8.6 per 90 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Saka-Ødegaard combination on right half-space is primary creative axis. Martinelli provides width and pace on left. Havertz makes late runs into box. xG per 90: 2.0 (FBref). Left-back overlaps create crossing opportunities.
tactical_patterns.defensive: Medium-high press with selective triggers. PPDA: 8.8 (FBref). Compact 4-4-2 mid-block out of possession. Rice screens passing lanes. Disciplined zonal marking.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Elite set-piece unit — Gabriel and Havertz primary aerial targets. Saka and Ødegaard delivery. 12 goals from set pieces this season (Football-Data.org). Set piece xG: 0.38 per match (FBref — highest in PL).
tactical_patterns.transitions: Controlled transitions — prefer to establish possession rather than direct counter. Saka and Martinelli can stretch on break. Recovery press within 5 seconds of loss.

strengths: Premier League's best set-piece unit (0.38 xG/match, 12 goals, FBref)
Defensive solidity — Saliba-Gabriel partnership (fewest big chances conceded in PL)
Tactical discipline and structural organization under Arteta
Squad depth across midfield and defense
weaknesses: Over-reliance on Saka for final-third creativity (team xG drops 34% without him)
Lack of clinical centre-forward (Havertz underperforming xG by 2.1)
Can become too structured — predictable in build-up against high press
Vulnerability on left side when Martinelli doesn't track back
Struggles to break down deep, compact blocks without set-piece bailout

name: FC Barcelona

tactical_patterns.build_up: Flick's positional play with high defensive line. CBs split wide, Casadó as single pivot. Koundé inverts from RB. Short progressive passing through midfield triangles. Progressive passing rate: 9.4 per 90 (FBref — highest in La Liga).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Yamal and Raphinha stretch width. Pedri and Olmo occupy half-spaces. Lewandowski holds and combines in zone 14. Overloads right half-space via Yamal-Koundé-Pedri triangle. xG per 90: 2.4 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.defensive: Extremely high press — Flick's signature. PPDA: 6.4 (FBref — most aggressive in La Liga). High defensive line (avg 48m from goal). Immediate counter-press on loss — 4-second recovery rule.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Lewandowski and Araújo primary targets. Raphinha and Olmo delivery. Set piece xG: 0.26 per match (FBref). Near-post flick routines from corners.
tactical_patterns.transitions: Ultra-fast vertical transitions on turnover. Yamal's pace stretches defenses immediately. Raphinha makes diagonal counter-runs. 13 transition goals this season (Football-Data.org).

strengths: Most aggressive press in La Liga (PPDA 6.4, FBref)
Youth-driven energy — Yamal, Cubarsí, Gavi provide relentless intensity
Highest progressive passing rate in La Liga (9.4 per 90, FBref)
Tactical flexibility under Flick — can switch between 4-2-3-1 and 4-3-3 mid-game
Lewandowski's clinical finishing (19 goals, +1.6 vs xG overperformance)
weaknesses: Extremely high defensive line exploitable with pace behind (conceded 9 goals on through balls, Football-Data.org)
Defensive vulnerability from set pieces (conceded 7 set-piece goals, worst in La Liga top 4)
Injury-prone key players (Pedri, Olmo, Araújo — combined 28 games missed)
Can be overwhelmed by physical, direct midfields that bypass press
Reliance on individual brilliance when structured play is disrupted

name: Paris Saint-Germain

tactical_patterns.build_up: Luis Enrique's positional play — patient build-up with GK in possession. Hakimi pushes high, Nuno Mendes provides width. Vitinha as primary ball progressor from midfield. 3-2 build-up shape (one FB tucks in). Progressive passing rate: 8.8 per 90 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Width from Dembélé (right) and Barcola (left). Vitinha and Zaïre-Emery make third-man runs. Ramos' movement creates space for wide players. Half-space overloads via midfielder rotations. xG per 90: 2.2 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.defensive: High press with aggressive triggers — 70%+ possession reduces defensive exposure. PPDA: 7.6 (FBref). Counter-press immediately on loss. Back four holds high line (avg 46m from goal).
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Marquinhos primary target from corners. Fabian Ruiz delivery from free kicks. Set piece xG: 0.24 per match (FBref). Zonal marking defensively.
tactical_patterns.transitions: Devastating pace on break through Dembélé, Barcola, and Hakimi. 3v2 counter-attacks frequent. 12 transition goals this season (Football-Data.org). Prefer controlled transition over direct counter.

strengths: Elite ball progression — Vitinha + Hakimi create constant forward momentum (FBref)
Pace across front line and full-backs — devastating in transition (12 transition goals)
Luis Enrique's possession control (68% avg — highest in Europe's top 5 leagues)
Squad depth and tactical flexibility (4-3-3 → 3-4-3 mid-game)
Youth development pipeline — Zaïre-Emery and Barcola provide energy and intensity
weaknesses: Defensive fragility in high-stakes European matches (conceded 2+ in 4 of 6 CL games)
Lack of proven goalscorer at elite CL level post-Mbappé
High line exploitable with direct balls behind (conceded 8 through-ball goals, Football-Data.org)
Set-piece defending is a liability (conceded 6 set-piece goals, Ligue 1 worst in top 4)
Over-possession can become sterile — xG drops to 1.1 vs organized low blocks
